notes.title: v01.00.03
notes.content:
- added spanish localization

The game uses steams language settings, so if you want to change the language manually, just right click on the game in your library, choose settings and set your language preferences there

notes.title: v01.00.01
notes.content:
[list]
[*] add: French language was added
[*] fix: no longer crashes when music cannot be loaded (missing features on Windows "N" Versions) - for now the game just starts without music in that case (better fix hopefully soon)
[*] fix: log now shows game version
[*] fix: Multiplayer only checks major and minor part of version in order to find lobbies (but should be no big deal due to autoupdate)
[/list]
